title: Split cycles of a finite projective exact tail
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal, and $\mathcal P$ a class of $R$-modules whose members are projective and such that $M_1,M_{12}\in\mathcal P$ and $M_{12}\cong M_1\oplus M_2$ imply $M_2\in\mathcal P$. Let $C$ be an integer-indexed cochain complex in the abelian category of $R$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], zero in degrees greater than an integer $b$, with all terms in $\mathcal P$, and exact in degrees greater than an integer $n$. There exist an $R$-module $Z\in\mathcal P$ and a monomorphism $\iota:Z\to C^n$ with $\iota d^n=0$ such that $Z\to C^n\to C^{n+1}$ is exact. Moreover, writing $F=(R/I)\otimes_R-$, the map $F\iota$ is monic and the sequence $FZ\to FC^n\to FC^{n+1}$ is exact.

source.place: Tag 0BC9, lemma-lift-acyclic-complex, proof, first paragraph: splitting the finite projective tail; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BC9

proof.text: Use the summand condition with the explicit zero module PUnit to prove zero membership and invariance under isomorphism, using LinearEquiv.prodUnique and prodComm.

For every i construct the cycle sequence Z^i -> C^i -> Z^(i+1). The kernel universal property and the monic inclusion of the next cycles make it exact. Exactness at i+1 makes its outgoing arrow epic via epi_toCycles and cyclesIsoSc'. Descend by natural-number induction on an upper-bound distance. At distance zero iCyclesIso identifies cycles with the term. At the successor split the short exact sequence with splittingOfProjective, use isoBinaryBiproduct, biprod.braiding and ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd, and apply the summand hypothesis.

At n and n+1 obtain the two splittings. Their images under extension of scalars remain splittings by ShortComplex.Splitting.map. Thus the mapped inclusion at n+1 is monic. Transfer exactness of the mapped split cycle sequence at n to the sequence with outgoing arrow F(d^n), using exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono. Return the cycle object and its original and mapped kernel properties.

theorem exists_acyclicLift_splitCycles
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R → Prop)
    (hprojective : ∀ M, P M → Projective M)
    (hsummand : ∀ M₁ M₂ M₁₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R,
      P M₁ → P M₁₂ → Nonempty (M₁₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (M₁ × M₂)) → P M₂)
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ)
    (b n : ℤ) (hupper : C.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hP : ∀ i, P (C.X i)) (hexact : ∀ i, n < i → C.ExactAt i) :
    ∃ Z : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P Z ∧
      ∃ ι : Z ⟶ C.X n, ∃ hz : ι ≫ C.d n (n + 1) = 0,
        ∃ hzF : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map ι ≫
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map (C.d n (n + 1)) = 0,
          Mono ι ∧ (ShortComplex.mk ι (C.d n (n + 1)) hz).Exact ∧
          Mono ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map ι) ∧
          (ShortComplex.mk
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map ι)
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map (C.d n (n + 1)))
            hzF).Exact
